global: A bowl of spicy ramen with rich, reddish broth and tender chashu pork. Thinly sliced green onions crown the noodles, all served in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface, subtle rim, and faint orange residue stains along inner edge.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is deep red, glossy, and rich, swirling around thin noodles and topped with shredded green onions.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows caramelized brown exterior, tender white interior, and visible fat marbling with slight sheen.
